claims.text: Siklus 4 tak terdiri dari langkah hisap, kompresi, tenaga, dan buang yang memerlukan dua putaran poros engkol penuh.

sources.title: Four-stroke engine
sources.quote: At this point the crankshaft (assuming all 4 strokes take 720° of crankshaft rotation) has completed a full 360° revolution.

claims.text: Langkah hisap menurunkan piston untuk menarik campuran udara dan bahan bakar ke dalam silinder melalui katup masuk.

sources.title: Four-stroke engine
sources.quote: In this stroke the intake valve must be in the open position while the piston pulls an air-fuel mixture into the cylinder by producing a partial vacuum (negative pressure) in the cylinder through its downward motion.

claims.text: Langkah kompresi menaikkan piston untuk memadatkan campuran tersebut, meningkatkan suhu dan tekanan sebelum percikan busi.

sources.title: Internal combustion engine
sources.quote: In this stroke, both valves are closed and the piston moves upward reducing the combustion chamber volume which reaches its minimum when the piston is at TDC.

claims.text: Langkah tenaga menghasilkan dorongan ke bawah akibat ekspansi gas pembakaran bertekanan tinggi.

sources.title: Internal combustion engine
sources.quote: The pressure of the combustion gases pushes the piston downward, generating more kinetic energy than is required to compress the charge.

claims.text: Langkah buang mendorong sisa gas hasil pembakaran keluar melalui katup buang.

sources.title: Four-stroke engine
sources.quote: During the exhaust stroke, the piston, once again heads downwards from a point to another point (B.D.C. to T.D.C. in an Otto cycle) while the exhaust valve is open.

claims.text: Siklus empat tak pada mesin Otto memerlukan dua putaran poros engkol penuh.

sources.title: Otto cycle
sources.quote: The intake stroke and compression stroke require one rotation of the engine crankshaft. The power stroke and exhaust stroke require another rotation.

claims.text: Langkah hisap melibatkan massa udara atau campuran bahan bakar dan oksigen yang ditarik ke dalam silinder oleh piston yang bergerak turun.

sources.title: Otto cycle
sources.quote: A mass containing a mixture of fuel and oxygen is drawn into the cylinder by the descending piston, it is compressed by the piston rising, the mass is ignited by a spark releasing energy in the heat, the resulting gas is allowed to expand as it pushes the piston down, and finally the mass is exhausted as the piston rises a second time.

claims.text: Langkah kompresi menaikkan piston untuk memadatkan campuran bahan bakar, meningkatkan suhu dan tekanan sebelum penyalaan.

sources.title: Otto cycle
sources.quote: Mechanically this is the isentropic compression of the air/fuel mixture in the cylinder, also known as the compression stroke.

claims.text: Langkah tenaga menghasilkan dorongan pada piston ke bawah akibat ekspansi gas pembakaran bertekanan tinggi.

sources.title: Otto cycle
sources.quote: The increased high pressure exerts a force on the piston and pushes it towards the BDC.

claims.text: Langkah buang mendorong sisa gas hasil pembakaran keluar silinder saat piston naik.

sources.title: Otto cycle
sources.quote: As the piston moves from "BDC" (point 1) to "TDC" (point 0) with the exhaust valve opened, the gaseous mixture is vented to the atmosphere and the process starts anew.
